sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which part of your hand should you primarily use to grip a ball securely when throwing it over a long distance?
options: A) The center of your palm
B) Your fingertips and base of fingers
C) Only the tip of your thumb
D) The back of your hand
questions.answer: B) Your fingertips and base of fingers

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of 'cushioning' the ball when receiving a pass in football?
options: A) To make the ball bounce higher
B) To instantly shoot it at the goal
C) To absorb its speed and keep it close to your body
D) To pass it backward immediately
questions.answer: C) To absorb its speed and keep it close to your body

questions.question_text: When performing an overarm throw, which foot should step forward as you release the ball?
options: A) The foot on the same side as your throwing arm
B) Both feet simultaneously
C) You should not step forward at all
D) The foot opposite to your throwing arm
questions.answer: D) The foot opposite to your throwing arm

questions.question_text: What does a good 'follow-through' motion ensure after striking a ball with a bat or racket?
options: A) It stops the ball from going too far
B) It maximizes power and maintains balance
C) It prevents the opponent from catching the ball
D) It ensures the bat safely drops to the ground
questions.answer: B) It maximizes power and maintains balance

questions.question_text: How should your fingers be positioned when catching a fast ball arriving at chest height?
options: A) Pointing downwards towards your toes
B) Closed tightly into fists
C) Pointing upwards, with thumbs close together forming a 'W' shape
D) Spread wide apart and crossed over each other
questions.answer: C) Pointing upwards, with thumbs close together forming a 'W' shape

questions.question_text: Why are 'Little Steps' (quick, short foot movements) crucial before receiving or striking an object?
options: A) They confuse the referee
B) They help you constantly adjust your body position for perfect alignment
C) They look stylish during a match
D) They help you run faster in a straight line
questions.answer: B) They help you constantly adjust your body position for perfect alignment

questions.question_text: When dribbling a basketball or football past a defender, where should your eyes primarily focus?
options: A) Fixed firmly on the ball
B) Looking backward at your teammates
C) Staring directly at your own feet
D) Kept up, scanning the field and the opponent's movements
questions.answer: D) Kept up, scanning the field and the opponent's movements

questions.question_text: What is tactical interception in team sports?
options: A) Throwing the ball out of bounds
B) Stealing a pass intended for an opposing player by anticipating its path
C) Tripping the opponent to get the ball
D) Standing still while the opponent scores
questions.answer: B) Stealing a pass intended for an opposing player by anticipating its path

questions.question_text: To achieve maximum distance and power when kicking a ball, which part of the foot should strike the ball?
options: A) The very tip of the toes
B) The top of the foot (the laces area)
C) The back of the heel
D) The outer edge of the foot
questions.answer: B) The top of the foot (the laces area)

questions.question_text: What is the best stance to adopt while waiting to receive a fast serve or pitch?
options: A) Standing completely straight with feet together
B) Sitting on the ground
C) Feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and weight on the balls of the feet
D) Leaning heavily backward on your heels
questions.answer: C) Feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and weight on the balls of the feet

questions.question_text: Describe the correct physical posture your arms and hands should maintain right before catching a high-flying ball. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Extend your arms upward with elbows slightly bent. Keep your hands open close together, creating a cup shape, with fingers spread out wide to receive the ball safely.

questions.question_text: What happens during a proper follow-through after throwing a ball? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A proper follow-through involves letting your throwing arm continue its natural motion across your body, which maximizes throwing power and prevents injury to your shoulder.

questions.question_text: Explain how to correctly cushion a fast-moving soccer ball when receiving it with your foot. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Relax your receiving foot and pull it back slightly upon impact. This absorbs the ball's speed, keeping it close to your body for better control.

questions.question_text: Why are quick 'Little Steps' important when preparing to strike a moving object? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Taking quick little steps helps you adjust your body position accurately. It allows you to stay balanced and properly align yourself with the approaching object.

questions.question_text: State the importance of keeping your eyes on the ball while attempting to strike it. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Watching the ball closely until the moment of impact ensures perfect timing. It allows you to hit the exact center of the object with maximum accuracy.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are teaching a beginner how to strike a cricket ball or baseball. Describe the stance and swinging motion required. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Stand sideways with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent for balance. Grip the bat firmly, keep your eyes focused on the incoming ball, and swing smoothly through the line of the ball, transferring your body weight from the back foot to the front.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are dribbling a basketball down the court while a defender guards you. Describe the footwork and hand movements you use to protect the ball. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would keep my knees bent and stay low to maintain a strong center of gravity. I would use quick, stuttering footwork to change pace and bounce the ball on the side away from the defender, using my free arm as a protective shield.

questions.question_text: Explain the complete mechanical sequence of an accurate overarm throw to hit a distant target. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Start by standing sideways to the target and point your non-throwing arm toward it. Step forward with your opposite foot to generate momentum. Bring your throwing arm back, bend your elbow, and vigorously whip your arm forward. Release the ball at eye level and allow your arm to follow through completely across your body.

questions.question_text: Describe how a player uses advanced tactical movement and interception skills to steal a pass meant for an opponent. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The player must constantly scan the field and anticipate the opponent's next move. By taking quick, agile little steps, they position themselves strategically in the passing lane. Just as the ball is thrown, they burst forward using explosive footwork to catch the ball mid-air, successfully intercepting it before it reaches the intended receiver.
